name: Fights with Panache
description: You are a skilled and stylish combatant, using flair and finesse in battle.
connectionOptions: One PC is your rival in combat prowess.
You once put on an impressive fighting display to impress one PC.
You and one PC fought back-to-back against overwhelming odds.
additionalEquipment: A stylish piece of clothing or accessory

abilities.name: Flourish
abilities.description: When you use a light or medium weapon, you add +1 to damage and can choose to flourish, adding style to your attack.

abilities.name: Trick Shot
abilities.description: You can perform a difficult shot or attack maneuver. The attack is hindered, but if successful, it inflicts 1 additional point of damage.

abilities.name: Acrobatic Attack
abilities.description: When you use movement as part of an attack, you gain an asset to the attack.

abilities.name: Dazzling Attack
abilities.description: When you hit with a melee attack, you can choose to dazzle the target, hindering their next action.

abilities.name: Flamboyant Parry
abilities.description: When you use a light or medium weapon, you add +1 to your Speed defense tasks.

abilities.name: Magnificent Flourish
abilities.description: When you use Flourish, you add +3 to damage instead of +1.

abilities.name: Mastery of Panache
abilities.description: Once per day, you can perform an amazing combat feat that guarantees success on one attack or defense action.
